comment.text: PPM1D E525 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Bowel tumors; CNS tumors; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cnsbrain; Uterine tumors. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.
Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
FDA references are separate gene-level evidence until the exact biomarker, tumor, setting, and current label have been checked.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting PPM1D residue E525 have been observed in uterine tumors, CNS tumors, and bowel tumors. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.

comment.text: PPM1D E525* is an allele annotation observed in Cancer Hotspots v2 at the E525 hotspot or indel region. This documents recurrence in the source cohorts; allele-specific function, tumor-specific significance, reference-sequence mapping, and clinical actionability require independent review.

report_comment.text: The PPM1D E525* alteration has been observed in uterine tumors, CNS tumors, and bowel tumors. Its functional and clinical significance require allele- and tumor-specific assessment.
